_comment: Project-local hooks for open-second-brain. The kg-common verification harness (docs/harness-verification/WIRING.md): Phase-0 observe-only eventlog + Phase-1 deny gate on action tools. Explicit pipe-matcher, never '*'. kg_common is editable-installed in .venv; scripts fall back to the sibling checkout via PYTHONPATH. The deny gate is fail-open until scripts/hooks/harness-gate-policy.json gets a rule (currently []).
